hooks.command: sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' | cut -d- -f1); [ -n "$sid" ] && sprite list --prefix "affordance-$sid" 2>/dev/null | awk -v p="affordance-$sid" 'index($1,p)==1{print $1}' | while read -r s; do sprite -s "$s" x -- bash -lc "sprite-env services list | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -r -n1 sprite-env services stop; sprite-env services list | jq -r '.[] | select(.http_port != null) | .name' | xargs -r -n1 sprite-env services delete" 2>/dev/null; done; true
